title: VedAI Clinical Psychiatry AI Assistant
summary: Designed reusable LLM instruction and context templates for psychiatric workflows, with a multi-agent human-in-the-loop review layer for sensitive clinical outputs.
overview: VedAI was a private clinical-AI platform where I worked on structuring expert psychiatric workflows into reliable LLM instruction and context systems. The work focused on turning implicit clinical reasoning into reusable, well-documented templates and on building review paths that keep a human in the loop for sensitive outputs. This is prior work (late 2024 to mid 2025); details are shared at a high level under confidentiality.
myRole: As an AI researcher on the project, I designed reusable instruction and context templates, a multi-agent review workflow with risk triage and escalation logic, and evaluation and documentation standards that aligned clinical and engineering review. I coordinated with clinicians and engineers on workflow refinement and UI/UX.

sections.title: What I Worked On
content: Designed reusable LLM instruction and context templates covering 80+ psychiatric workflow scenarios, supporting more consistent outputs across complex cases.
Designed a multi-agent review workflow with risk triage and escalation logic to support human-in-the-loop review of sensitive clinical AI outputs.
Developed model evaluation and documentation standards for workflow refinement, output review, and review milestones.
Coordinated clinicians and engineers on workflow refinement, documentation, and UI/UX improvements.

sections.title: Scope & Limitations
sections.content: This was a contributor role on a private platform, and the work is not publicly shareable. The summary above describes my contributions at a high level rather than reproducing any proprietary content.

outcomes: Built reusable instruction and context templates across 80+ psychiatric workflow scenarios.
Standardized workflows across 12 psychiatric case categories, cutting new-scenario configuration time from 4 weeks to 2.
Established a multi-agent, human-in-the-loop review path with risk triage for sensitive outputs.
Created model evaluation and documentation standards that aligned clinical and engineering review.
